Usage: agentic-roslyn-tool <command> [options]

Commands:
  split-types   Split C# files that declare more than one top-level type (SA1402).

split-types options:
  --input <dir|file|csv|list|->    A directory to scan, one .cs file, a CSV with a 'file' column,
                                   a text file with one path per line, or '-' to read paths from stdin.
  --repo-root <path>               Repository root used for git operations. Defaults to the current directory.
  --manifest <path>                Path to the plan manifest CSV. Defaults to sa1402-split-manifest.csv beside a list
                                   input, or in --repo-root for a directory or stdin input. Only plan writes it.
                                   Must name a file. renames and content refuse a symbolic link here.
  --report <path>                  Where renames and content record what they did. Defaults to the manifest path
                                   with .report.csv as its extension. Not accepted with the plan phase.
                                   Replaces a file in the report format. Refuses any other existing file.
  --phase plan|renames|content     Which phase to run. Defaults to plan, which changes no source file.
  --dry-run                        Same as --phase plan. Kept for older scripts. Cannot be combined with --phase.
  --json                           Print one JSON report to stdout instead of CSV.
  --require-header <text>          Require and prepend this file header. Off by default.
  --exclude <path-substring>       Skip inputs whose path contains this substring. Repeatable.
  --collision-naming file-first|type-first
                                   Name for two inputs that emit the same file name. file-first, the default,
                                   gives A.Shared.cs. type-first gives Shared.A.cs, which passes SA1649.
                                   The plan records the value; renames and content reuse it when the flag is absent.
  --file-naming stylecop|metadata  SA1649 convention for
